violation_type.title: Toothbrushes - Out of Reach when Not in Use (26 TAC §747.3121(a)(2))
violation_type.short_title: Toothbrushes - Out of Reach when Not in Use
violation_type.typical_finding: The children's toothbrushes were observed in a cup on the restroom sink accessible to the children when not in use and not labeled with the children full name.
